title: University of Cyprus Doctoral Scholarships and Fee Waivers
description: Funded doctoral places at the University of Cyprus combining a tuition fee waiver with paid teaching or research assistantships, allocated by departments as part of admission.
amount: Full tuition fee waiver plus a stipend for teaching/research assistant duties

title: Cyprus University of Technology Scholarships
field: Engineering, health sciences, management, communication, fine and applied arts
description: Merit scholarships and tuition reductions for postgraduate students at the Cyprus University of Technology in Limassol, including support for doctoral candidates through assistantships.
amount: Partial tuition fee reduction; doctoral candidates may receive an assistantship stipend

title: University of Nicosia Academic Merit Scholarships
description: Tuition-reduction scholarships for international students at the largest private university in Cyprus, awarded on academic record and, for some schemes, financial circumstances.
amount: Up to 50% tuition fee reduction (higher for select awards)

title: Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters (Cyprus-hosted programmes)
description: Fully funded, integrated master's programmes run by a consortium of universities across at least three countries, some coordinated by or including Cypriot institutions. Students apply to the individual programme consortium.
amount: EUR 1,400 per month, full tuition, insurance and travel/installation allowances

deadlines.term: 2027 intake (deadline varies by programme, Oct 2026 - Jan 2027)
